Name: VMV - Vapius Coins Wallet Currency
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
This is a tiny mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url] that turns Vapius Coins into a Wallet Currency, meaning you'll carry them around wherever you go without them taking up precious inventory space. Picked up Coins will automatically be stored in a shared between all players wallet.

You can check how many Vapius Coins you currently have in the Special Items & Powers Tab, or when approaching a market stall in the hamlet.
Vapius Coins will be deducted from the wallet when making purchases.
